verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: E VEIO a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם בְּת֥וֹךְ בֵּית־ הַמֶּ֖רִי אַתָּ֣ה יֹשֵׁ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֵינַיִם֩ לָהֶ֨ם לִרְא֜וֹת וְלֹ֣א רָא֗וּ אָזְנַ֨יִם לָהֶ֤ם לִשְׁמֹ֙עַ֙ וְלֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֔עוּ כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām bə·ṯō·wḵ bêṯ- ham·me·rî ’at·tāh yō·šêḇ ’ă·šer ‘ê·na·yim lā·hem lir·’ō·wṯ wə·lō rā·’ū ’ā·zə·na·yim lā·hem liš·mō·a‘ wə·lō šā·mê·‘ū kî bêṯ mə·rî hêm
verses.literal: Son of man you are living in a rebellious house They have eyes to see but do not see and ears to hear but do not hear for they are a rebellious house
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, tu habitas no meio da casa rebelde, que tem olhos para ver e não vê, e tem ouvidos para ouvir e não ouve; porque eles são casa rebelde.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֗ם עֲשֵׂ֤ה לְךָ֙ כְּלֵ֣י גוֹלָ֔ה וּגְלֵ֥ה יוֹמָ֖ם לְעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם וְגָלִ֨יתָ מִמְּקוֹמְךָ֜ אֶל־ מָק֤וֹם אַחֵר֙ לְעֵ֣ינֵיהֶ֔ם אוּלַ֣י יִרְא֔וּ כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām ‘ă·śêh lə·ḵā kə·lê ḡō·w·lāh ū·ḡə·lêh yō·w·mām lə·‘ê·nê·hem wə·ḡā·lî·ṯā mim·mə·qō·wm·ḵā ’el- mā·qō·wm ’a·ḥêr lə·‘ê·nê·hem ’ū·lay yir·’ū kî bêṯ mə·rî hêm·māh
verses.literal: Therefore son of man pack your bags for exile . . . In broad daylight . . . set out from your place and go to another as they watch Perhaps they will understand though they are a rebellious house
verses.literalPt: Tu, pois, ó filho do homem, prepara mobílias para mudares, e de dia muda aos olhos deles; e do teu lugar mudarás para outro lugar aos olhos deles; bem pode ser que reparem nisso, ainda que eles são casa rebelde.

verses.original: וְהוֹצֵאתָ֨ כֵלֶ֜יךָ כִּכְלֵ֥י גוֹלָ֛ה יוֹמָ֖ם לְעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם וְאַתָּ֗ה תֵּצֵ֤א בָעֶ֙רֶב֙ לְעֵ֣ינֵיהֶ֔ם כְּמוֹצָאֵ֖י גּוֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ṣê·ṯā ḵê·le·ḵā kiḵ·lê ḡō·w·lāh yō·w·mām lə·‘ê·nê·hem wə·’at·tāh tê·ṣê ḇā·‘e·reḇ lə·‘ê·nê·hem kə·mō·w·ṣā·’ê gō·w·lāh
verses.literal: Bring out your baggage for exile by day as they watch . . . Then in the evening as they watch go out like those who go into exile
verses.literalPt: Aos olhos deles, pois, tirarás para fora, de dia, as tuas mobílias, como quem vai mudar; então tu sairás de tarde aos olhos deles, como quem sai mudando para o cativeiro.

verses.original: לְעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם חֲתָר־ לְךָ֣ בַקִּ֑יר וְהוֹצֵאתָ֖ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·‘ê·nê·hem ḥă·ṯār- lə·ḵā ḇaq·qîr wə·hō·w·ṣê·ṯā bōw
verses.literal: As they watch dig through the wall and carry your belongings out through it
verses.literalPt: Faze para ti, à vista deles, uma abertura na parede, e tira-as para fora, por ali.

verses.original: לְעֵ֨ינֵיהֶ֜ם עַל־ כָּתֵ֤ף תִּשָּׂא֙ בָּעֲלָטָ֣ה תוֹצִ֔יא פָּנֶ֣יךָ תְכַסֶּ֔ה וְלֹ֥א תִרְאֶ֖ה אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־ מוֹפֵ֥ת נְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְבֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lə·‘ê·nê·hem ‘al- kā·ṯêp̄ tiś·śā bā·‘ă·lā·ṭāh ṯō·w·ṣî pā·ne·ḵā ṯə·ḵas·seh wə·lō ṯir·’eh ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ kî- mō·w·p̄êṯ nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā lə·ḇêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And as they watch lift your bags to your shoulder and take them out at dusk cover your face so that you cannot see the land For I have made you a sign to the house of Israel
verses.literalPt: Aos olhos deles, nos seus ombros, às escuras as tirarás, e cobrirás o teu rosto, para que não vejas a terra; porque te dei por sinal à casa de Israel.

verses.original: וָאַ֣עַשׂ כֵּן֮ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צֻוֵּיתִי֒ כֵּ֠לַי הוֹצֵ֜אתִי כִּכְלֵ֤י גוֹלָה֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וּבָעֶ֛רֶב חָתַֽרְתִּי־ לִ֥י בַקִּ֖יר בְּיָ֑ד בָּעֲלָטָ֥ה הוֹצֵ֛אתִי עַל־ כָּתֵ֥ף נָשָׂ֖אתִי לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wā·’a·‘aś kên ka·’ă·šer ṣuw·wê·ṯî kê·lay hō·w·ṣê·ṯî kiḵ·lê ḡō·w·lāh yō·w·mām ū·ḇā·‘e·reḇ ḥā·ṯar·tî- lî ḇaq·qîr bə·yāḏ bā·‘ă·lā·ṭāh hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ‘al- kā·ṯêp̄ nā·śā·ṯî lə·‘ê·nê·hem
verses.literal: So I did . . . as I was commanded I brought out my bags for exile by day and in the evening I dug through the wall by hand I took my belongings out at dusk carrying them on my shoulder as they watched
verses.literalPt: E fiz assim, como se me deu ordem; as minhas mobílias tirei para fora de dia, como mobílias do cativeiro; então à tarde fiz, com a mão, uma abertura na parede; às escuras as tirei para fora, e nos meus ombros as levei, aos olhos deles.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֧י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י בַּבֹּ֥קֶר לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay bab·bō·qer lê·mōr
verses.literal: And in the morning the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: E, pela manhã, veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הֲלֹ֨א אָמְר֥וּ אֵלֶ֛יךָ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑רִי מָ֖ה אַתָּ֥ה עֹשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām hă·lō ’ā·mə·rū ’ê·le·ḵā bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl bêṯ ham·me·rî māh ’at·tāh ‘ō·śeh
verses.literal: Son of man hasn’t the rebellious house of Israel asked you What are you doing
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, porventura não te disse a casa de Israel, aquela casa rebelde: Que fazes tu?

verses.original: אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֑ה הַנָּשִׂ֞יא הַמַּשָּׂ֤א הַזֶּה֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְכָל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֥מָּה בְתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr ’ă·lê·hem kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh han·nā·śî ham·maś·śā haz·zeh bī·rū·šå̄·lam wə·ḵāl bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer- hêm·māh ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: Tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem and all the house of Israel who are there
verses.literalPt: Dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Esta carga refere-se ao príncipe em Jerusalém, e a toda a casa de Israel, que está no meio dela.

verses.original: אֱמֹ֖ר אֲנִ֣י מֽוֹפֶתְכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֗יתִי כֵּ֚ן יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה לָהֶ֔ם בַּגּוֹלָ֥ה בַשְּׁבִ֖י יֵלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr ’ă·nî mō·w·p̄eṯ·ḵem ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî kên yê·‘ā·śeh lā·hem bag·gō·w·lāh ḇaš·šə·ḇî yê·lê·ḵū
verses.literal: You are to say I am a sign to you Just as it happened here so will it be done to them they will go into exile as captives
verses.literalPt: Dize: Eu sou o vosso sinal. Assim como eu fiz, assim se lhes fará a eles; irão para o exílio em cativeiro.

verses.original: וְהַנָּשִׂ֨יא אֲשֶׁר־ בְּתוֹכָ֜ם אֶל־ כָּתֵ֤ף יִשָּׂא֙ בָּעֲלָטָ֣ה וְיֵצֵ֔א בַּקִּ֥יר יַחְתְּר֖וּ לְה֣וֹצִיא ב֑וֹ פָּנָ֣יו יְכַסֶּ֔ה יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־ יִרְאֶ֥ה לַעַ֛יִן ה֖וּא אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nā·śî ’ă·šer- bə·ṯō·w·ḵām ’el- kā·ṯêp̄ yiś·śā bā·‘ă·lā·ṭāh wə·yê·ṣê baq·qîr yaḥ·tə·rū lə·hō·w·ṣî ḇōw pā·nāw yə·ḵas·seh ya·‘an ’ă·šer lō- yir·’eh la·‘a·yin hū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: And at dusk the prince among them will lift his bags to his shoulder and go out They will dig through the wall to bring him out He will cover his face so he cannot see the land
verses.literalPt: E o príncipe que está no meio deles levará aos ombros as mobílias, e às escuras sairá; farão uma abertura na parede para as tirarem por ela; o seu rosto cobrirá, para que com os seus olhos não veja a terra.

verses.original: וּפָרַשְׂתִּ֤י אֶת־ רִשְׁתִּי֙ עָלָ֔יו וְנִתְפַּ֖שׂ בִּמְצֽוּדָתִ֑י וְהֵבֵאתִ֨י אֹת֤וֹ בָבֶ֙לָה֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְאוֹתָ֥הּ לֹֽא־ יִרְאֶ֖ה וְשָׁ֥ם יָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·raś·tî ’eṯ- riš·tî ‘ā·lāw wə·niṯ·paś bim·ṣū·ḏā·ṯî wə·hê·ḇê·ṯî ’ō·ṯōw ḇā·ḇe·lāh ’e·reṣ kaś·dîm wə·’ō·w·ṯāh lō- yir·’eh wə·šām yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: But I will spread My net over him and he will be caught in My snare I will bring him to Babylon the land of the Chaldeans yet he will not see it and there he will die
verses.literalPt: Também estenderei a minha rede sobre ele, e será apanhado no meu laço; e o levarei à Babilônia, à terra dos caldeus, e contudo não a verá, ainda que ali morrerá.

verses.original: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר סְבִיבֹתָ֥יו עֶזְרֹה וְכָל־ אֲגַפָּ֖יו אֱזָרֶ֣ה לְכָל־ ר֑וּחַ וְחֶ֖רֶב אָרִ֥יק אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯāw ʿɛz·rōh wə·ḵāl ’ă·ḡap·pāw ’ĕ·zā·reh lə·ḵāl rū·aḥ wə·ḥe·reḇ ’ā·rîq ’a·ḥă·rê·hem
verses.literal: And I will scatter to every wind all the attendants around him and all his troops and I will draw a sword to chase after them
verses.literalPt: E a todos os ventos espalharei os que estiverem ao redor dele para seu socorro, e a todas as suas tropas; e desembainharei a espada atrás deles.

verses.original: וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בַּהֲפִיצִ֤י אוֹתָם֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וְזֵרִיתִ֥י אוֹתָ֖ם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh ba·hă·p̄î·ṣî ’ō·w·ṯām bag·gō·w·yim wə·zê·rî·ṯî ’ō·w·ṯām bā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: And they will know that I am the LORD when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them throughout the countries
verses.literalPt: Assim saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, quando eu os dispersar entre as nações e os espalhar pelas terras.

verses.original: וְהוֹתַרְתִּ֤י מֵהֶם֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר מֵחֶ֖רֶב מֵרָעָ֣ב וּמִדָּ֑בֶר לְמַ֨עַן יְסַפְּר֜וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם בַּגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֣אוּ שָׁ֔ם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ṯar·tî mê·hem ’an·šê mis·pār mê·ḥe·reḇ mê·rā·‘āḇ ū·mid·dā·ḇer lə·ma·‘an yə·sap·pə·rū ’eṯ- kāl- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem bag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer- bā·’ū šām wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: But I will spare a few of them . . . from sword and famine and plague so that in the nations to which they go they can recount all their abominations . . . Then they will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Mas deles deixarei ficar alguns poucos, escapos da espada, da fome, e da peste, para que contem todas as suas abominações entre as nações para onde forem; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Então veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם לַחְמְךָ֖ בְּרַ֣עַשׁ תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּמֵימֶ֕יךָ בְּרָגְזָ֥ה וּבִדְאָגָ֖ה תִּשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām laḥ·mə·ḵā bə·ra·‘aš tō·ḵêl ū·mê·me·ḵā bə·rā·ḡə·zāh ū·ḇiḏ·’ā·ḡāh tiš·teh
verses.literal: Son of man eat your bread with trembling and drink your water with quivering and anxiety
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, o teu pão comerás com tremor, e a tua água beberás com estremecimento e com receio.

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֶל־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֡רֶץ כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֩ אֲדֹנָ֨י יְהוִ֜ה לְיוֹשְׁבֵ֤י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ אֶל־ אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַחְמָם֙ בִּדְאָגָ֣ה יֹאכֵ֔לוּ וּמֵֽימֵיהֶ֖ם בְּשִׁמָּמ֣וֹן יִשְׁתּ֑וּ לְמַ֜עַן תֵּשַׁ֤ם אַרְצָהּ֙ מִמְּלֹאָ֔הּ מֵחֲמַ֖ס כָּֽל־ הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’el- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh lə·yō·wō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim ’el- ’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl laḥ·mām biḏ·’ā·ḡāh yō·ḵê·lū ū·mê·mê·hem bə·šim·mā·mō·wn yiš·tū lə·ma·‘an tê·šam ’ar·ṣāh mim·mə·lō·’āh mê·ḥă·mas kāl- hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bāh
verses.literal: Then tell . . . the people of the land that this is what the Lord GOD says about those living in Jerusalem and in the land of Israel They will eat their bread with anxiety and drink their water in dread for their land will be stripped of everything in it because of the violence of all who dwell in it
verses.literalPt: E dirás ao povo da terra: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS acerca dos habitantes de Jerusalém, na terra de Israel: O seu pão comerão com receio, e a sua água beberão com susto, pois a sua terra será despojada de sua abundância, por causa da violência de todos os que nela habitam.

verses.original: וְהֶעָרִ֤ים הַנּֽוֹשָׁבוֹת֙ תֶּחֱרַ֔בְנָה וְהָאָ֖רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֑ה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ā·rîm han·nō·wō·šā·ḇō·wṯ te·ḥĕ·raḇ·nāh wə·hā·’ā·reṣ šə·mā·māh ṯih·yeh wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: The inhabited cities will be laid waste and the land will become desolate Then you will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: E as cidades habitadas serão devastadas, e a terra se tornará em desolação; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: E veio ainda a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם מָֽה־ הַמָּשָׁ֤ל הַזֶּה֙ לָכֶ֔ם עַל־ אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר יַֽאַרְכוּ֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וְאָבַ֖ד כָּל־ חָזֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām māh- ham·mā·šāl haz·zeh lā·ḵem ‘al- ’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr ya·’ar·ḵū hay·yā·mîm wə·’ā·ḇaḏ kāl- ḥā·zō·wn
verses.literal: Son of man what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel The days go by and every vision fails
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, que provérbio é este que vós tendes na terra de Israel, dizendo: Prolongar-se-ão os dias, e perecerá toda a visão?

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ הִשְׁבַּ֙תִּי֙ אֶת־ הַמָּשָׁ֣ל הַזֶּ֔ה וְלֹֽא־ יִמְשְׁל֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ ע֖וֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֚י אִם־ דַּבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם קָֽרְבוּ֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וּדְבַ֖ר כָּל־ חָזֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ĕ·mōr ’ă·lê·hem kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hiš·bat·tî ’eṯ- ham·mā·šāl haz·zeh wə·lō- yim·šə·lū ’ō·ṯōw ‘ō·wḏ bə·yiś·rā·’êl kî ’im- dab·bêr ’ă·lê·hem qā·rə·ḇū hay·yā·mîm ū·ḏə·ḇar kāl- ḥā·zō·wn
verses.literal: Therefore tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says I will put an end to this proverb and in Israel they will no longer . . . recite it But . . . say to them The days are at hand when every vision will be fulfilled
verses.literalPt: Portanto, dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Farei cessar este provérbio, e já não se servirão mais dele em Israel; mas dize-lhes: Os dias estão próximos e o cumprimento de toda a visão.

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶ֥ה ע֛וֹד כָּל־ חֲז֥וֹן שָׁ֖וְא וּמִקְסַ֣ם חָלָ֑ק בְּת֖וֹךְ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō yih·yeh ‘ō·wḏ kāl- ḥă·zō·wn šāw ū·miq·sam ḥā·lāq bə·ṯō·wḵ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: For there will be no more false visions or flattering divinations within the house of Israel
verses.literalPt: Porque não haverá mais alguma visão vã, nem adivinhação lisonjeira, no meio da casa de Israel.

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֲדַבֵּר֙ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲדַבֵּ֤ר דָּבָר֙ וְיֵ֣עָשֶׂ֔ה לֹ֥א תִמָּשֵׁ֖ךְ ע֑וֹד כִּ֣י בִֽימֵיכֶ֞ם בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֗רִי אֲדַבֵּ֤ר דָּבָר֙ וַעֲשִׂיתִ֔יו נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ă·ḏab·bêr ’êṯ ’ă·šer ’ă·ḏab·bêr dā·ḇār wə·yê·‘ā·śeh lō ṯim·mā·šêḵ ‘ō·wḏ kî ḇî·mê·ḵem bêṯ ham·me·rî ’ă·ḏab·bêr dā·ḇār wa·‘ă·śî·ṯîw nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: because I the LORD will speak whatever word I speak and it will be fulfilled without delay For in your days O rebellious house I will speak a message and bring it to pass declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Porque eu, o SENHOR, falarei, e a palavra que eu falar se cumprirá; não será mais adiada; porque em vossos dias, ó casa rebelde, falarei uma palavra e a cumprirei, diz o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Furthermore, the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Veio mais a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם הִנֵּ֤ה בֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֹֽמְרִ֔ים הֶחָז֛וֹן אֲשֶׁר־ ה֥וּא חֹזֶ֖ה לְיָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וּלְעִתִּ֥ים רְחוֹק֖וֹת ה֥וּא נִבָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām hin·nêh ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ’ō·mə·rîm he·ḥā·zō·wn ’ă·šer- hū ḥō·zeh lə·yā·mîm rab·bîm ū·lə·‘it·tîm rə·ḥō·w·qō·wṯ hū nib·bā
verses.literal: Son of man take note that the house of Israel is saying The vision that he sees is for many years from now he prophesies about the distant future
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, eis que os da casa de Israel dizem: A visão que este tem é para muitos dias, e ele profetiza de tempos que estão longe.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה לֹא־ תִמָּשֵׁ֥ךְ ע֖וֹד כָּל־ דְּבָרָ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲדַבֵּ֤ר דָּבָר֙ וְיֵ֣עָשֶׂ֔ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ĕ·mōr ’ă·lê·hem kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh lō- ṯim·mā·šêḵ ‘ō·wḏ kāl- də·ḇā·rāy ’ă·šer ’ă·ḏab·bêr dā·ḇār wə·yê·‘ā·śeh nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Therefore tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says None . . . of My words will be delayed any longer The message I speak will be fulfilled declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Portanto dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Não será mais adiada nenhuma das minhas palavras; e a palavra que falei se cumprirá, diz o Senhor DEUS.
